features.title: Chaise extension for total relaxation
features.text: Stretch fully on the chaise after long days, perfect for naps, movie marathons, or simply enjoying an indulgent moment of comfort.

features.title: Spacious seating for family and friends
features.text: Generous width accommodates three plus chaise room, making it ideal for shared evenings, game nights, or welcoming guests.

features.title: Semi-leather finish for luxury and ease
features.text: Smooth semi-leather feels soft yet durable, giving you the premium touch of leather with the practicality of everyday care.

features.title: Supportive cushioning that lasts
features.text: Pocket-spring and foam blend keeps seats buoyant and comfortable, ensuring support that doesn’t flatten over time.

features.title: Toffee tan that warms your interiors
features.text: The rich tan tone adds a cozy yet contemporary feel, complementing wood, cream, or dark accents with effortless charm.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
